objections: City is redundant for the listed utility tasks: impossible travel and never-seen-country rules work from geo_country (kept) plus the 10-degree coordinate bins, as the rationale itself concedes.

Merging only groups under 10 still leaves within-country cities (office locations) and foreign cities of a single business traveller, which the catalog trap flags as unique per week; for a public Recital 26 release this is unnecessary disclosure that the staff page can link.
Suppress removes that residual risk at almost no utility cost.
